acquisition method: All data was acquired with the mass spectrometer operating in automatic data dependent switching mode.
alkylation reagent: alkylated for 15 minutes with 20mM iodoacetamide at 30°C.
alkylation concentration: alkylated for 15 minutes with 20mM iodoacetamide at 30°C.
cleavage agent: samples were digested overnight at 37°C with 20 μg sequencing grade trypsin (90057, Thermo Fisher Scientific).
enrichment method: set aside for phospho-peptide enrichment using TiO2 (Titansphere Phos-TiO Bulk 10 um, GL Sciences, Tokyo, JP).
instrument: Samples were analyzed by a Q Exactive HFX mass spectrometer connected to Easy nLC 1200 reverse-phase chromatography system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: separated over an EASY-Spray column, (50 cm × 75 μm ID, PepMap RSLC C18, Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: Peptides were labelled with 0.8 mg of TMT label (TMT10plex™ Isobaric Label Reagent Set, Thermo Fisher Scientific).
reduction reagent: Samples were reduced for 30 minutes with 8 mM dithiothreitol
reduction concentration: Samples were reduced for 30 minutes with 8 mM dithiothreitol
